objective: Compile exact provenance-bound Federation telemetry into the canonical V4 experiment measurement row contract without inventing scores or creating provider authority.

expected_information_gain.denominator_semantics: explicit targeted questions or uncertainty units registered before measurement

mission_value.denominator_semantics: explicit mission value target or approved value bound

proof_strength_gain.denominator_semantics: explicit targeted proof axes registered before measurement

reversibility.denominator_semantics: boolean observation normalized against 1.0; executed rollback evidence remains separate

estimated_cost.denominator_semantics: mission max_cost or separately approved finite cost ceiling

hard_invariants: all eight dimensions must be present exactly once
each dimension names one exact observation and metric key
every numerator is observed, finite and provenance-bound
every denominator is explicit, positive and provenance-bound
qualitative labels are never converted to numbers
synthetic observations cannot enter observed experiment evidence
stored normalized values remain assertions and are recomputed from raw inputs
OBSERVED_RAW is not independent verification or value proof
no provider call, Sheets write, IAM/WIF mutation, external effect or promotion is created by the compiler
truth_boundary: This contract defines a deterministic internal evidence compiler. It does not create real measurements, independent verification, provider proof, DATA_READY, positive expected value, incubation, production maturity or authority.
